text:
kira_support: FYI support ticket #CS-1439 from Acme AI — customers reporting p95/p99 jumps and timeouts since ~09:20 UTC. They say interactive prompts go from ~1.8s to 12s p95 and p99s up to 40s. They attached repro and curl calls.

sam_eng_platform: seeing alerts on the ingress dashboard — admission queue length spiked at 09:18 and worker_backlog increased. Priority-fairness counters show tenant(acme) inflight jumped to ~820.

alex_oncall: can you paste the sample curl from Acme? need headers to check routing/tenant id.

kira_support: pasted below —
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-ACME-xxx' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-1","input":"hello"}'
```

jenni_sre: interesting — tenant-scoped concurrency limits should cap inflight to 200 by default. looks like auth-token rotation might have bypassed the quota key. checking auth proxy logs.

marco_infra: rolling logs: ingress-proxy shows lots of 202 Accepted then long queue hold before dispatch to workers. sample line: `ingress: tenant=acme inflight=812 admit=delayed reason=queue`

sam_eng_platform: I can repro locally on staging by replaying their token header. When we set TENANT_CONCURRENCY=200, admission still lets them through because request routing lost tenant tag (regression in 2025-04-15 release).

alex_oncall: deploy-bot reports the 2025-04-15/sha@7f3d9 deploy touched header-middleware. rollback?

deploy-bot: rollback initiated for service=ingress-proxy to sha@6b1a2 (previous stable).

sam_eng_platform: while rollback runs, mitigation suggestions:
- enable temporary tenant soft-throttle (drop priority=low)
- route acme to secondary pool with higher worker-count
- disable cross-tenant batching for acme requests

kira_support: Acme agrees to temporary throttling policy as long as we keep them updated.

jenni_sre: quick commands to check and apply soft-throttle:
```bash
# view current admit config
kubectl -n redwood get configmap admit-config -o yaml
# patch to set soft-throttle for tenant acme
kubectl -n redwood patch configmap admit-config --type merge -p '{"data":{"soft_throttle_acme":"true"}}'
```

marco_infra: increased worker replica set for pool-secondary by +6 to absorb burst: `kubectl scale deploy worker-pool-secondary --replicas=14 -n redwood`

alex_oncall: rollback completed at 09:38 UTC. ingress-proxy back to sha@6b1a2. I'm seeing inflight drop from 820 -> 160 over ~5m. p95 trending back toward 2.1s.

sam_eng_platform: confirm: admission_rejects spiked earlier because the admission controller wasn't applying tenant tag. now rejects are down. adding an alert for header-middleware unit test to prevent regression.

kira_support: I updated ticket #CS-1439 with timeline and actions, Acme support lead notified and will monitor for next 24h.

jenni_sre: follow-ups: add endpoint-level telemetry for tenant tag presence, add an e2e test for header middleware to CI, and run canary for header-middleware patch before broad rollouts.

marco_infra: creating a short postmortem doc and a runbook entry for ‘ingress header loss -> tenant concurrency bypass’.

kira_support: thanks everyone :thumbsup: — I'll keep the thread open until ACME confirms stable for 24h.
